title: Little boy kisses his cat and shows what true friendship looks like
description:
Some friendships don’t need words; they just need a whisker and a little boy’s heart!

In this adorable clip shared by Carrie, a tiny tot has fully committed to the belief that his best buddy is, in fact, a cat.

And not just any cat, but his ride-or-die, forever friend!

While other kids are forming soccer teams, this little legend has already drafted his feline soulmate.

This duo is officially paw-some!
